productionMl.name: Active Learning — Labeling Pipeline
productionMl.description: Labeling large volumes of sensor data is the bottleneck in every production ML cycle, and the labels that already exist are not necessarily right. I led development of labeling workflows built around Active Learning, so the pipeline ranks which samples are worth a human's attention instead of working the queue in order — and runs the same scoring pass over already-annotated data, where disagreement between model and label surfaces likely mislabels.
productionMl.imageAlt: Active-learning loop: a model trains on the labeled data pool, identifies uncertain samples in the unlabeled pool, and requests human review, which feeds new labels back into training.

productionMl.name: Performance Analysis — Overfit Mapping
productionMl.description: Models that look strong in the lab do not always hold up at inference time, and an aggregate accuracy number hides where they fail. I built analytical tooling that compares lab and production behaviour and maps where a model overfits and underfits across its input space, turning a single metric into a picture of which regions are actually trustworthy — wired into the release path so the check runs before deployment, not after.
highlights: Gates every release · ~3 bugs caught per model
productionMl.imageAlt: Lab versus production model behaviour side by side: clean converging accuracy curves in the lab, degraded and unstable curves in deployment, with a heatmap magnified to locate the failing regions.

productionMl.name: Time-Series Anomaly Detection & Enrichment
productionMl.role: Data Science Analyst @ DRS RADA Technologies
productionMl.description: Sensor time-series arrives noisy, and the noise costs twice — once in training time, once in detection accuracy. I developed time-series analysis, forecasting and anomaly-detection algorithms with signal-noise and outlier reduction ahead of training, and separately automated data enrichment and labeling by integrating external APIs with tracking systems to recover signal the pipeline had been dropping.
highlights: Forecasting + anomaly detection on sensor streams
Noise and outlier reduction ahead of training
In production · thousands of tracks recovered
productionMl.imageAlt: The two costs of unrefined sensor data: a noisy time-series stream lengthening the training cycle, and anomalies hidden inside that noise reducing detection accuracy.
